items.title: Critical Cisco SD-WAN 0-Day Vulnerability Exploited Since 2023 to Gain Root Access
items.description: Cisco has disclosed a critical zero-day vulnerability in its Catalyst SD-WAN products that threat actors have exploited since 2023 to bypass authentication and achieve root access. items.title: Hacker Jailbreaks Claude AI to Write Exploit Code and Steal Government Data
items.description: A hacker exploited Anthropic’s Claude AI chatbot over a month-long campaign starting in December 2025, using it to identify vulnerabilities, generate exploit code, and exfiltrate sensitive data from Mexican government agencies.
